title: Sarwar ke wafadar Abbas kaha ho
body:
sarwar ke wafadaar abbas kaha'n ho
lo aagaya bazaar abbas kaha'n ho
ye kucha-o-bazaar ye aghiyaar ka lashkar
sadqe ke khajoor aur to kisi haath me pathhar
<<DIVIDER>>
marjaye na geerat se kahi'n abid e bimaar
is aalame ghurbat me rasan basta hai haalat
abbas bulaati hai tumhe gheerate sadaat
aane me na ab der karo sheh ke wafadaar
<<DIVIDER>>
soncho to zara aale payambar ke muhafiz
ghazi mere bhai meri chadar ke muhafiiz
ye shaam ka bazaar kuja itrate athaar
waada hai kabhi pyaas se na aahe'n bharegi
<<DIVIDER>>
paani ki sakina bhi shikayat na karegi
dariya se chale aao do-aalam ke madadgaar
zindaan-e-musibat me sakina huwi be aas
dariya se chale aao zara der ko abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
duniya se guzarjaye na ghut ghut keye ghamkhaar
haathau me rasan hai isey dafnaungi kaise
is qaide museebat me kafan laungi kaise
ghurbat me sakina ki shahadat ke hai'n aasaar
<<DIVIDER>>
hai saqt musibat ki ghadi aale nabi par
pohncho meri imdaad ko aye mere baradar
ab dakhila-e-ahle haram hai sare darbaar
darbaar me lejaate hai'n be-maqna-o-chadar
<<DIVIDER>>
shayed mujhe mujboor samjhte hai'n sitamgar
aajao zara lashkar-e-sarwar ke alamdaar
riqqat hai sare farshe aza hashr bapa hai
ashkon se bilal e shahe wala ne likha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo bain ke rota hai har ek sheh ka azadaar
